title: Weekend Grindhouse Schedule - Fri 8/14 - Sun 8/16
contentHtml:
Playing this weekend @ 420Grindhouse.

Showtime starts each day @ 3pm EST/12pm PST.

==Friday==

Funky Cheese Friday

  • Silent But Deadly (1986)
  • Futuresport (1998)
  • Star Worms II: Attack of the Pleasure Pods (1985)

Friday Grindhouse-A-Go-Go

  • Attack of the Beast Creatures (1985)
  • The Bride with White Hair (1993)
  • Effects (1979) aka Death's Director

Friday Night Freak Show

  • Endangered Species (2002) aka Earth Alien
  • Demons at the Door (2004)
  • Lightning Field (1991) aka Lightning Incident

==Saturday==

Psychedelic Saturday

  • Q: The Winged Serpent (1982)
  • Running Cool (1993)

  • Cannibal Apocalypse (1980) aka Cannibals in the Streets

Red Light Saturday Night

  • Tomcat Angels (1991)

==Sunday==

The Sunday Classics

  • They're Playing With Fire (1984)

Last Call Sunday Night

  • 5ive Girls (2006)
